title: Waikahalulu FRIDAYS ONLY POLO
body: Quiet from afar. Loud in meaning. This performance polo is part of the Waikahalulu Capsule with Sig On Smith, featuring a tonal jacquard map print of Honolulu’s Chinatown - the home base of Sig On Smith. A minimalist front gives way to a bold triangle back hit, symbolizing stability and movement. Cut from a breathable poly-blend with just the right stretch, this polo brings together performance construction and cultural roots for an elevated fit. Fridays only. Everyday ready.

title: Waikahalulu COUNTRY CLUB TEE
body: Fridays only. Everyone welcome.Part of the Waikahalulu Capsule with Sig On Smith, this tee flips the script on exclusivity. What looks like a members-only back print is actually a tribute to open community -rooted in the rhythm of Honolulu’s Chinatown, where creatives, families, and entrepreneurs all collide. A soft, easy-wearing cotton tee with a bold back hit and minimal front detail. Designed to move through city streets and everyday life.

title: Waikahalulu COUNTRY CLUB LONGSLEEVE
body: A print with place.The Waikahalulu Country Club Longsleeve is part of our capsule with Honolulu’s Sig On Smith, designed around Chinatown as a vibrant nexus of community - where culture moves through markets, side streets, youth collectives, and creative exchange. Hand-cut map art anchors the back graphic, celebrating Sig On Smith’s neighborhood - each piece is worn with the memories that surroud it.

title: Sig on Smith Golf Bag
body: The Waikahalulu Golf Bag marks the first-ever carry piece from Puttwell - created in partnership with Honolulu-based creative house Sig On Smith. Inspired by the energy of Chinatown - a gathering place for families, merchants, artists, and youth, this lightweight bag features Sig on Smith's signature map print - an abstract grid celebrating movement, memory, and creative flow. Blue pop accents echo the vibrancy of the neighborhood’s storefronts and skyline. Blending performance function with street-informed design, the Waikahalulu bag is both utility and tribute. A piece made to carry more than just your clubs.

title: SIG ON SMITH GOLF GLOVE RIGHT HAND
body: Crafted from premium polyester, the Sig on Smith Golf Glove merges performance grip with street detail. Subtle overlays nod to topographic city maps, grounding the design in both movement and place. Breathable perforations and a custom Puttwell pull tab offer modern functionality for wherever the day takes you.

title: SIG ON SMITH GOLF GLOVE LEFT HAND
body: Crafted from premium polyester, the Sig on Smith Golf Glove merges performance grip with street detail. Subtle overlays nod to topographic city maps, grounding the design in both movement and place. Breathable perforations and a custom Puttwell pull tab offer modern functionality for wherever the day takes you.

title: PUTTWELL COURSE SOLID POLO
body: Effortless on the course. Elevated off it. The Course Solid Polo is your daily go-to, cut from a lightweight performance fabric that moves with you. Engineered for breathability and stretch, this core silhouette is built to handle the heat while keeping a refined shape throughout the round. Minimal branding and a relaxed fit that is cut for comfort and finished with subtle, clean detailing that elevates it beyond the basics.

title: GILLIGAN Vest
body: Classic Layers. Contemporary Flow. The Gilligan Vest blends vintage golf cues with modern edge. Knit from a soft, mid-weight cotton blend, it delivers easy warmth without the bulk - perfect for layering over a polo or tee. The ribbed V-neck and hem offer a structured finish, while subtle chest embroidery and tonal detailing keep it clean and elevated. Designed with a relaxed, slightly boxy fit, it’s a nod to timeless sport style - reimagined for today’s round and beyond.

title: DRIVE MOCK NECK L/S
body: Engineered for movement and designed for precision. The Drive Mock Neck Long Sleeve is a high-performance essential - built from a textured, breathable fabric with a streamlined fit. This minimalist silhouette and sleek base layer delivers next-to-skin comfort with a high-stretch, high-performance fabric - anchored by a bold Puttwell collar detail and discreet Puttwell logo at the wrist, this layer works hard without feeling heavy. Layer up. Lock in.

title: Extra Butter Performance Vest
body: The Extra Butter Performance vest from our new Drop Zone Collection balances performance and polish with a weather-ready shell and discreet branding. This quilted vest with button-down closure features minimal co-branded logos on the chest and back bringing thoughtful design to the forefront. Lightweight layering built for cool rounds, urban walks, and in-between seasons.

title: Driver Cover
body: The Puttwell Driver Cover combines premium protection with elevated style, ensuring your golf clubs stay safe both on and off the course. Featuring durable material and a secure fit, this driver cover showcases the signature Puttwell logo on the front and the Know Your Roll logo on the back side for understated sophistication.

title: Mallet Putter Cover
body: Elevated protection with a heritage edge. The Puttwell Mallet Cover is crafted from premium synthetic leather, designed to shield your flatstick with structured padding and a soft interior lining. Classic green piping and dual-logo embroidery bring a refined nod to tradition, while a magnetic closure ensures a secure, quiet fit on and off the green. Built for the modern player with a respect for the game’s roots.

title: Blade Putter Cover
body: The Puttwell Blade Putter Cover is built for clean protection and lasting edge - crafted from durable synthetic leather with soft-touch lining and reinforced structure. Embroidered with the signature “Know Your Roll” tagline and bold Puttwell wordmark, it’s designed to deliver quiet confidence every time you reach for the flatstick. A magnetic closure ensures a secure fit, round after round.

title: Metal Ball Marker 2 Pack
body: The Metal Ball Marker 2 Pack offers a unique way to keep track of your ball with bold Puttwell brand icons. Featuring two different colors, the high quality markers ensure you never lose sight of your place on the green.

title: Metal Ball Marker
body: The Puttwell Metal Ball Marker is designed for seamless use and subtle presence. Crafted from polished metal with a matte enamel finish, the circular base features simple alignment markings while the raised "Know Your Roll" on one side and Puttwell branding on the other side, the top marker detaches smoothly for quick placement and pick-up. Precision-made with a secure magnetic hold - because your short game deserves details that keep pace.

title: Know Your Roll mini towel
body: Precision starts with the details—keep your golf clubs, balls, and tees in the best condition with the Know Your Roll Mini Towel. Featuring a large Know Your Roll graphic on one side and bold Puttwell branding on the other side, this premium microfiber towel delivers superior absorbency and quick-drying performance. Designed for durability with a waffle-knit texture to effectively clean dirt and debris, it includes a woven loop for easy attachment to your bag. This high quality cleaning towel is a true standout.

title: Fast Back Putter Cover
body: Sleek protection for the modern flatstick. The Puttwell Fast back Putter Cover is tailored for performance profiles - featuring a contoured silhouette and premium synthetic leather shell. A tonal PW monogram adds subtle distinction, while padded interior lining safeguards your putter with every grab. Finished with a magnetic closure for smooth, secure functionality, this cover delivers streamlined coverage with timeless appeal.

title: Putting Disks
body: Dial in your distance with precision. The Puttwell Putting Discs are built from durable material, offering a consistent roll and soft touch for repeatable practice. Each disc features minimal alignment markings and subtle Puttwell messaging - designed to reinforce rhythm, not distract from it. Whether you’re honing pace on the practice green or warming up before a round, this three-pack gives you the tools to “Know Your Roll” and eliminate the dreaded three-putt. Includes carabiner clip for easy bag attachment.

title: Collide Performance Short
body: Engineered with performance and designed for comfort. The Collide Performance Short is built for movement and adaptability. Made from a water-resistant, lightweight fabric, it offers a relaxed fit with maximum mobility. An elastic waistband with an internal drawcord ensures a secure, adjustable fit, while zippered pockets keep essentials locked in on the go. Designed to perform through every round—and every condition.

title: Deep Cuts Tee
body: The Deep Cuts Tee pays tribute to the hidden gems—the overlooked tracks and the underground favorites. Made from premium cotton with a relaxed fit, this tee features a back graphic inspired by crate-digging, late sets, and the sounds that shape community.

title: Know Your Roll Tee
body: The Know Your Roll Tee features a bold back graphic and vintage-washed finish for a lived-in feel with premium construction. Crafted with a relaxed fit, this tee is built from soft cotton jersey that wears easy and stands up to repeated rounds. It’s a constant reminder- know your roll, play your game. Your go-to tee with something to say on and off the course.

title: Club Car Tee
body: Classic wheels with clean lines. The Club Car Tee features a vintage-inspired outlined graphic of a golf cart on the front—simple, iconic, and easy to wear. Made from soft, garment-washed cotton with a slightly relaxed fit, this tee delivers everyday comfort with a nod to the golden era of the game. Timeless design, everyday staple and just the right amount of drive.

title: Puttwell Wordmark L/S Tee
body: The Wordmark Long Sleeve Tee is an everyday essential that is crafted from soft, mid-weight cotton jersey with a classic crew neck and cuffed sleeves for structure and shape. Featuring the signature Puttwell logo front and center, this piece balances comfort and identity in a silhouette built for daily wear.

title: Wordmark Tee
body: A wardrobe staple, the Puttwell Wordmark Tee delivers effortless style with a clean, minimalist design. Featuring a subtle yet bold chest logo, this tee is crafted from premium heavyweight cotton for a structured yet comfortable fit. This vintage wash tee adds a timeless feel and everyday versatility.

title: Snake Driver Cover
body: The Snake Driver Cover combines premium protection with elevated style, ensuring your golf clubs stay safe both on and off the course. Featuring durable material and a secure fit, this driver cover showcases and all-over custom snake print with the signature Puttwell logo on the front and the Know Your Roll logo on the back side for understated sophistication.

title: Sig Zane Toon Tee
body: The Sig Zane Toon Tee celebrates a collaboration with renowned Hawaii designer, Sig Zane, featuring exclusive custom artwork by celebrated cartoon artist. The iconic design captures a playful scene of Sig unwinding on the golf course while paying homage to Hawaii nostalgia. Crafted to wear beyond the fairway, this premium tee offers a laid back aesthetic yet playful approach. Cut with a spacious fit in the sleeves and torso, making it relaxed and versatile enough to wear with anything.
